findings.what: IDEA: the raised READMIT arm, BASE + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.98 (exp87f/g/h). This is the missing half of the 743929 two-arm read, not a new family (it is the high side of I-431 / I-139). Mechanism: on x138 the lowdet pool holds all pooled peaks >= 0.3, and readmit restores pool peaks >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE within 4 um of an open end. At 0.965 (= DET_THRESHOLD) these are ILP-discarded above-threshold peaks. At 0.98 the [0.965, 0.98) readmits drop out, and lowrefine (keyed to the same variable) stops refining that band, which touches only a few gapfill rows (gapfill adds +111 nodes in total). Expected effect: nodes -0.1..-1.1% (1,365 readmits = 1.13%), which is worth +0.0001..+0.0011 on the linear node term at 0.001 per 1%, minus the edges those readmits closed. The lab says readmits rarely sit near GT (73/13,284), while the board said lower was better on JT's base. EV ~0 +- 0.001 public; P('+') ~0.2-0.3 after a '-' at 0.94, ~0.15 after a '0'. Runtime cost on the ~100-clip hidden run: ~0 (READMIT arms ran 1,388 s vs 1,409 s for exp70g). Cheapest honest gate: the RA98 dummy gate (R24S-6) and then the LB rule (the v3 codes against the base display). No lab arm: the lab was wrong in sign 4/4 on this family.
